home.title: Simple image tools, right in your browser.
home.description: Convert your images between JPG, PNG and WebP formats. No uploads, no installation, and no complicated software.
home.toolsDescription: Free online tools for everyday image conversion.
home.privacyTitle: Your images stay on your device.
home.privacyDescription: Our image conversion tools process your files directly in your browser. Your images do not need to be uploaded to a server.
home.browserBasedDescription: Image conversion happens directly on your device using your browser.
home.freeToUseDescription: Convert your images without creating an account or installing additional software.
home.fastProcessingDescription: Since your files are processed locally, there is no need to wait for an upload to a remote server.
home.ctaDescription: Choose a tool and get started for free.

upload.qualityDescription: Higher quality produces a larger file. Lower quality can reduce the file size.

errors.tooManyPixels: This image has too many pixels to process safely. Please choose a smaller image.
errors.readFailed: Unable to read the image. Please try another file.
errors.conversionFailed: Image conversion failed. Please try again.

converter.yourImagesProcessed: Your images are processed directly in your browser. Files are not uploaded to our server.
converter.selectImageDescription: Select a {format} image from your device or drag and drop it into the converter.
converter.convertImageDescription: Click the convert button. Your browser processes the image directly on your device.
converter.downloadResultDescription: Download your converted {format} image immediately after conversion.
converter.freeDescription: Yes. This online {input} to {output} converter is free to use. You do not need to install software, create an account, or upload your images to a server.
converter.notUploadedDescription: No. Your images are processed directly in your browser. The conversion happens on your device, so your original image does not need to be sent to our server.
converter.fileSizeLimit: Is there a file size limit?
converter.fileSizeDescription: You can convert images up to 50MB. Images are also checked for dimensions and total pixel count to help prevent excessive browser memory usage during conversion.
converter.howDoIConvertDescription: Select your {input} image, click the convert button, and then download the converted {output} image. The entire process takes place directly in your browser.
converter.phoneSupport: Can I use this converter on a phone?
converter.phoneSupportDescription: Yes. The converter works in modern desktop and mobile browsers without requiring an app or additional software.
converter.maximumImageSize: What is the maximum image size?
converter.maximumImageSizeDescription: Images up to 50MB are supported. Images are also limited to 10,000 × 10,000 pixels and 50 million total pixels to help prevent excessive browser memory usage.
converter.toolIntro: Convert {input} images to {output} format with our free online image converter. Your images are processed directly in your browser without being uploaded to a server.
converter.toolWhy: Converting {input} to {output} can be useful for compatibility, editing, sharing, and web use.

footer.description: Simple and free image tools that work directly in your browser.
